title: Hierarchical Portable CAE.md Resolution

acceptance_gates.gate_1_higher_authority_override_protect: VERIFIED (Lower local CAE.md attempting to permit synthetic evidence, bypass operator gates, or mutate database raises ContextPrecedenceConflictError)
acceptance_gates.gate_2_missing_optional_layers_inherit_s: VERIFIED (Missing intermediate workspace or program CAE.md layers inherit higher authority without failure)
acceptance_gates.gate_3_inapplicable_rules_excluded_with_: VERIFIED (Phase-mismatched or prior-state rules are excluded with INAPPLICABLE_PHASE)
acceptance_gates.gate_4_hash_addressed_and_reproducible_c: VERIFIED (Repeated resolution of identical context hierarchy yields byte-identical hierarchy_sha256)
acceptance_gates.gate_5_explicit_budget_limits_enforced: VERIFIED (Items exceeding total token budget are excluded with BUDGET_EXCEEDED)
acceptance_gates.gate_6_state_entry_context_refresh: VERIFIED (State transition triggers refresh_state_context creating a refreshed context capsule)
acceptance_gates.gate_7_refresh_record_audit_lineage: VERIFIED (StateContextRefreshRecord captures source state, target state, included refs, excluded refs, and new hash)
acceptance_gates.gate_8_stale_context_rejected_after_tran: VERIFIED (Prior-state rules do not contaminate new target-state capsule)

false_proof_defenses.malicious_child_override_attack: BLOCKED (Child CAE.md injecting forbidden permission strings is blocked before inclusion)
false_proof_defenses.sibling_resolution_order_invariance: BLOCKED (Precedence is governed strictly by layer order, not file read or declaration order)

limitations: Model Policy & Tool Gating will be hardened in Mandate M52
Program-Agent Phase Binding Compiler will be formalized in Mandate M53
